images.title: Filling a Binairo row
images.purpose: Shows a 6 cell Binairo row with three given symbols and three found by the rules: H H V H V V.
images.composition: One row of 6 large square cells across the centre of the frame, with a small key underneath. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Six equal square cells in a row with dark outline colour (#2B2B2B) borders. Cell contents left to right: a horizontal line, a horizontal line, a vertical line, a horizontal line, a vertical line, a vertical line. The symbols in cells 1, 2 and 5 are drawn in teal (#0072B2); the symbols in cells 3, 4 and 6 are drawn in reddish purple (#CC79A7). Under the row a small key: a teal square with 'given' and a reddish purple square with 'found'. Exactly 6 cells, 3 horizontal and 3 vertical lines.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Pairs force the next symbol, and counting to half fills the rest.
images.description: Shows a 6 cell Binairo row with three given symbols and three found by the rules: H H V H V V.
images.context: Row H H V H V V: no three alike in a row and 3 of each symbol.

image_decisions.why: One row shows the two key rules of the puzzle without the clutter of a full grid.
